# What this document declares

Four entries are written under `indexes:`, and only two of them declare an
index. The second names `my index`, which cannot be an HTML id fragment: the
name reaches output as the section's id and as the fragment of every link to
it, so a section carrying a space in its id is one no link resolves against.
That entry is refused and says so, rather than emitting the invalid id in
silence. The third repeats a name already declared, and the fourth gives no
title, so its section is headed with its own name.

The document is therefore left with `main` and `people`, in that order.

# The marks

A mark that names no index files in the first declared one: [Alpha]{.index}.
A mark naming the second files there: [Bravo]{.index index="people"}.

A mark naming the refused entry names no index this document declares, so it
is reported and filed in the first: [Charlie]{.index index="my index"}.
